info.name: 🎁 Referral
info.description:
## 🎁 Referral Endpoints

Manage referral codes and track referrals for business owners.

### 📋 Endpoints

- **Get My Code**: Get or generate referral code (business_owner)
- **Get My Referrer**: Get referrer info if registered with a code
- **Get My Referrals**: List referrals and stats (business_owner)
- **Validate Code**: Validate a referral code (public)
- **Generate Code**: Force generate referral code (business_owner)

### 🔒 Auth

Most endpoints require business_owner role. Enable 'Send cookies' in Postman.
